scope: Native iPhone provider wait / Cancel / retry / cancelled preview / current-work preservation.
accepted: Actual native file picker opens the fixture and the read waits on a registered NSFilePresenter.
Opening backup status and Cancel are visible; Cancel is enabled/hittable while Restore from file is disabled.
Cancel restores enabled controls without an error or restore preview.
Retrying the same file opens the native restore review.
Cancelling that review preserves Newer current edit and does not add Backup missing task.
Persisted fixture has one task and zero pending changes.
harness: Debug-only presenter gated by the two exact backup-cancellation test bundle identifiers and an explicit launch argument. Holds only the first read; cancellation releases/removes the presenter. Production identifiers and normal debug launches never install it.
verification: 45 backup tests per independently owned repo pass after adding the debug presenter.
Isolated iOS app/widget/UI-test build passes; Simulator uses Xcode ad-hoc signing.
limitations: Local deterministic provider coordination, not actual offline iCloud or another remote provider.
No new Mac native cancellation, account-switch-during-read or relaunch acceptance.

cleanup.isolatedApp: terminated by test, then uninstalled with its test runner
cleanup.simulator: shutdown; originally booted primary phone/iPad untouched
cleanup.retained: xcresult, test/build logs, staged source and screenshot evidence
